name: CIMB
recent: CIMB 近期出现多项大股东（EPF、KWAP）的持股变动申报，同时市场消息指其菲律宾单位出售吸引 BPI、Metrobank 兴趣，公司则否认将私有化印尼 CIMB Niaga。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收环比增 2.6%，净利环比增 1.1%。
notable: 大股东 EPF 与 KWAP 在 10 月底至 11 月中多次申报持股变动。
媒体报道 BPI 与 Metrobank 对 CIMB 菲律宾单位的出售表达兴趣。
公司否认有关私有化印尼 CIMB Niaga 的计划。
risks: 大股东 EPF 与 KWAP 的持股变动申报频繁，需留意后续股权变化。
菲律宾单位出售及印尼单位私有化传闻相关消息反复，存在不确定性。

recent_en: CIMB has seen multiple substantial shareholder (EPF, KWAP) stake-change filings, while market reports say the sale of its Philippine unit has drawn interest from BPI and Metrobank; the company denied plans to privatise Indonesia's CIMB Niaga. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue rose 2.6% QoQ and net profit 1.1% QoQ.
notable_en: Substantial shareholders EPF and KWAP filed multiple stake-change notices from late October to mid-November.
Media reported that BPI and Metrobank expressed interest in the sale of CIMB's Philippine unit.
The company denied plans to privatise Indonesia's CIMB Niaga.
risks_en: Frequent stake-change filings by EPF and KWAP warrant attention to subsequent shareholding changes.
Reports on the Philippine unit sale and Indonesian unit privatisation have been repeated, creating uncertainty.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 5,573,143,000, up 2.6% QoQ and down 0.4% YoY; net profit was MYR 1,938,265,000, up 1.1% QoQ and 2.6% YoY; net margin was 34.8% versus 35.3% in the prior quarter.
